analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds one environment-variable table row at head line 1741 for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED. The row points at GatedDelta.swift (GatedDeltaPrefill.mode), and '0' keeps the stock Qwen GDN prompt kernel. No executable code, authorization, attestation, encryption, coordinator wire protocol, or key handling changes in the supplied evidence. The supplied base excerpts (lines 1-830) do not include the changed row, so I could not inspect the surrounding env-var table. The new variable is documentation of a kernel selection knob, apparently an inference performance toggle. It does not touch prefix-cache storage, cacheSalt scoping, TTL, the HMAC lookup keys, or the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate (T-041). The underlying Swift change (GatedDelta.swift) is not in this batch. If another batch contains a new GDN blocked prefill kernel, it should be reviewed separately for correctness and memory behavior (TB-007, T-028/T-029). That is only an integration question, not a finding here. This documentation change does not alter any trust-boundary assumptions or mitigations in the threat model.
